name: Uflex Limited
summary: Uflex Limited manufactures and sells flexible packaging materials and solutions in Indiaand internationally. It operates through Flexible Packaging Activities, Engineering Activities, and Others segments. The company offers bi-axially oriented polyethylene terephthalate films; bi-axially oriented polypropylene films; cast polypropylene films; metallized films; special effects films; and alox coated films. It also provides primers, water-based flexo and gravure inks, radiation-curable inks, solvent based inks, topcoats, heat seal coatings, barrier coatings for replacements, water-based blister coatings, energy curable and UV coatings, solvent-based matt and gloss coatings, UV LED coatings, an…
